_about: Retailer links for /where-to-buy/ (Kevin 2026-11-09, 1A). ONE data file; the page and its test read only this. A link appears ONLY if it was verified: Barnes & Noble = HTTP 200 and the binding's ISBN-13 on the page (curl, 2026-11-09); Walmart = Google-result URL whose slug has the binding ISBN-13 (pages are behind a human check); Google Play = HTTP 200 (curl, 2026-11-09); Amazon = ASIN from the SMP bookstore master (amazon-links.json / edition-registry.json), all 129 print ASINs ISBN-read-back with amazon-book.mjs 2026-11-09, sequential. Never type a URL without evidence; an edition with no entry shows 'Not listed'.
